part.text:
Refactored the SSG into a plugin-based architecture:

**New core:**
- `src/plugin.ts` — `Plugin` interface with `onStart`/`beforeBuild`/`onFile`/`afterBuild`/`onEnd` hooks (all sync, so `buildSite` stays a plain synchronous call)
- `src/engine.ts` — `SSGEngine` orchestrates file discovery + runs every plugin's hooks in order
- `src/config.ts` — `loadConfig()` loads the plugin list from `ssg.config.ts`, falling back to built-in defaults if absent
- `ssg.config.ts` (root) — default config wiring up the markdown + template plugins

**Built-in plugins in `./plugins/`:**
- `markdown-plugin.ts` — frontmatter parsing + markdown rendering + field resolution (extracted from the old `buildPage`)
- `template-plugin.ts` — Handlebars rendering/writing per page plus index generation
- `dev-server-plugin.ts` — HTTP/WebSocket serving, live-reload injection, and rebuild broadcasting (extracted from `serve.ts`)

**Rewired:** `src/site.ts` and `src/serve.ts` now build an `SSGEngine` from the configured plugin pipeline instead of hardcoding markdown/template/serve logic, while keeping `buildSite`, `startDevServer`, `TemplateEngine`, `injectLiveReload`, etc. as identical public APIs. Verified end-to-end via the compiled CLI (`build` and `serve`) in addition to the test suite.
